Name: IdaIda's Fishy Buildings (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][b][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
This is my first mod. It replaces the farmhouse and all 3 cabins with a Fishing hut aesthetic- perfect for the beach farm![/b]

[color=#a4c2f4]Made for Content Patcher. It's just a simple retexture, no seasonal changes for now. It's also not made with the in-game building recoloring in mind. maybe I'll add those things at some point.
[/color]


[color=#a4c2f4]This mod was inspired by [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196][color=#6fa8dc]House and building customization[/color][/url][color=#a4c2f4] by [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844][color=#6fa8dc]Lumisteria[/color][/url][color=#a4c2f4], specifically the lighthouse silo. I suggest using some buildings from there, for a complete fisherman's farm!

[b]Thank you to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193812592-kungfauxhustle/][color=#8e7cc3]kungfauxhustle[/color][/url] for making the AT conversion.[/b][/color]
